approval_source.question_set: Whether the helper's own failure record goes under the once-a-minute limit on the CheckTx path, and whether the host monitor alerts on the new count
approval_source.selected_as: Limit it on CheckTx (Recommended); Severity 2, any rise (Recommended)

reason: After P01_E04_CHECKTX_HELPER_FAILURES_2026-11-05, the helper's own failure record (LOCAL_FAILED_HELPER_LIFECYCLE_V1, up to 4 KiB) was still written for every helper failure that reaches it, on the CheckTx path too. Before P01_E04_CHECKTX_VERIFIER_2026-11-05 that could not repeat, because the first failure stopped the node. Now, while the helper is broken, anyone can send well-formed controls to a public node and each one writes a record, which can push the unit past the journal's rate limit, where the supervisor's own records are dropped. The new count was in the metrics file, but nothing alerted on it.

decisions.question: The helper's own failure record on the CheckTx path
decisions.selected: Under the same once-a-minute gate on CheckTx and recheck only
decisions.rule: While CheckTx or the mempool's recheck checks a transaction, the record of a helper that fails inside the check is held, not sent. If the check ends in a helper failure, the record goes through the admission line's once-a-minute gate: when a line is due, the record is written just before it; otherwise both are dropped and counted in the next line. A record from a check that ends otherwise is written as before. Startup, PrepareProposal, ProcessProposal and FinalizeBlock write every record, as P01_E04_VERIFIER_CLASS_2026-11-04 decided.

decisions.question: A monitor alert on the count
decisions.selected: Severity 2 on every host, on any rise
decisions.rule: The host monitor's rule admission_helper_failures (severity 2, validator, sentry and endpoint) fires when dytallix_app_admission_helper_failures_total rose since the monitor's last sample, and resolves at the next sample without a rise. A new start of the node (a different unit invocation) resets the counter, so all it counted since is the rise. It has no threshold value. Runbook: node/docs/operations/monitoring.md, Admission helper failures.

supersedes.part: On the CheckTx and recheck path only, the helper failure record is written at most once a minute, with the count of those not written; elsewhere every record is still written.

accepted_risks: Between lines, a CheckTx helper failure's own record is dropped; the next line carries the count and the latest refusal's message only.
does_not_authorize: any limit on the helper failure record at startup or in a proposal or block
deploying the new monitor to any host (the staging hosts' agents need their own approval)
any change to how a proposal or block treats a helper failure
